item.title: SiNiSistar2 HeatSeekar - Quality of Life Mod
item.description:
SiNiSistar2 HeatSeekar Mod is a free quality-of-life mod for SiNiSistar2 (DLsite/Steam) with native mouse bindings, mouse support for menus, improved display options and more...

TL;DR, take me to Download.

Intro

Greetings, fellow slugs.

It's been a couple of months since SiNiSistar2 launched on Steam and I uploaded the Modernization Mod Pack. I have been working on the tribute doujin game Rabiane and several other projects—which also include the website you are reading on right now.

item.title: Observation on Terrain Normal Mapping - Cave Levels
item.description:
When I was playing on the cave levels of SiNiSistar2 (v1.2.1), I noticed a unique lighting behavior—no matter which direction the light is from, the highlights were "locked" on the left edges of the stones.

They were clearly illuminated by her light when positioned to the right of Lelia; however, once Lelia passes them, they receded into darkness while still shimmering exclusively on their left edges. To figure out what caused that, I viewed the textures in Unity.
